notes.title: Version 1.12 now out - details + summary!
notes.content:
[h3]🔪🩸Greetings, fellow extreme horror enthusiasts! 😱[/h3]

It's been a few thrilling days since Gore Doctor made its debut on Steam, and I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude for your invaluable feedback and unwavering support! Your comments and suggestions have been instrumental in refining the game and addressing various issues. With each passing day, I've been hard at work pushing out updates to enhance the game's polish and overall experience. 🎮👻

Today, I'm excited to announce the release of version 1.12, which brings a slew of minor improvements and fixes. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Enhanced AI behavior on the Awakening location ensures that thugs will now pursue you even if you attempt to evade them by jumping on the bleacher seatings. 
[*] The Kitchen Lady fight has been fine-tuned with louder footsteps and minor adjustments to her positioning vs ground. 
[*] Blood decals no longer awkwardly connect to the knife of the Kitchen Lady during the intro cut-scene. 
[*] Various materials got improvements for a more immersive experience. 
[*] Added sounds to the draggable wood crates to enhance realism. 
[*] Fixed a small bug related to the cinema repertoire item, allowing both sides of the leaflet to be visible. 
[*] Plus, several other minor tweaks and changes. 
[/list]

Additionally (in case you missed them), I'd like to highlight some of the key changes and fixes introduced in previous updates:

[list]
[*] Resolved issues where certain inventory items would disappear in specific scenarios. 
[*] Added helpful hints in the "Awakening" and "Sanctum of Madness" locations to guide players. 
[*] Fixed an issue in "Sanctum of Madness" where the old hint persisted after providing electricity to the door. 
[*] Introduced extra textures to enemies' clothing for added variety. 
[*] Implemented a pause feature when using Alt-Tab, preventing automatic scene progression after loading. 
[*] Adjusted the number of bullets in the pistol on the "Awakening" location for consistency. 
[*] Various optimization enhancements and minor bug fixes. 
[/list]

At this juncture, the game should be free of any major bugs. However, if you encounter any issues worth addressing, please don't hesitate to share them in the comments section. Your feedback, along with any accompanying screenshots, is immensely valuable in ensuring a seamless gaming experience for all.ːsteamhappyː 📝🎮

Thank you once again for your unwavering support, and I sincerely hope that Gore Doctor continues to provide you with spine-tingling excitement and a much-needed respite from the daily grind. 💼👻

Happy gaming! 🎮👾

notes.title: Gore Doctor version 1.10 - Changelog
Gore Doctor comes out on March 22!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/64e5af99530963087cb5ff757ed40b7b8d9d45a9.png[/img]

[h3] 🩸Exciting News: Gore Doctor Release Date Announced!🩸 [/h3]

We're thrilled to announce that Gore Doctor finally has a release date! We just got the final confirmation from Steam, so [b]mark your calendars for March 22nd[/b] – that's when you'll plunge into the chilling gameplay crafted by Dr. Gorberg himself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/428ee838862f746dd4957accb590fcb2caf860a1.png[/img]

As a reminder, in the game you play as a man kidnapped by a gang of thugs, who is imprisoned in the doctor's institute and tries to find an escape. At every step, however, he will encounter mutant madmen who are the result of the doctor's inhuman experiments, as well as crazy traps and puzzles to solve. And all this in a thick, dark and bloody atmosphere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/d5295672ee41f18c45d47f8a581e6c5b9d19d098.gif[/img]

Delve into the twisted tale of Dr. Abnel Gorberg, once a revered expert in psychiatry and medicine, driven to madness by the loss of his beloved wife, Scarlett. Convinced that only death can grant solace, he embarks on a terrifying journey, inflicting suffering and death upon those imprisoned within his institute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/a50236a6992bb678875b5b88c189a993988f0791.gif[/img]

Playing Gore Doctor isn't just about uncovering the doctor's harrowing story; it's also about testing your own limits. Will you endure the horrors and emerge unscathed?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/234b861d2ed99c0fafed7f0c90b13011f481ab99.gif[/img]

Excitingly, we've updated our demo on Steam, and we're diligently working on delivering Linux and Mac versions at launch (fingers crossed!). Plus, brace yourselves for an irresistible launch discount on Gore Doctor, making it the perfect time to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

Prepare for an unforgettable descent into madness on March 22nd – Gore Doctor awaits, beckoning the brave and the bold to confront their darkest fears.

As always fearfully Yours,

The Gore Doctor Development Team 👻🕹️

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: Gore Diary #4 - Diving into Madness!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/b671b9efe9e75a4a0384fffe7fad096bbc411029.png[/img]

[h3][b]Greetings, horror aficionados!💀[/b][/h3]

We're thrilled to share a new Gore Diary with you and as usual we would like to use this opportunity to give you an update on the progress of Gore Doctor, our upcoming blood-curdling horror game that will plunge you into the depths of madness and terror.😱 As we traverse the twisted corridors of Dr. Abnel Gorberg's tormented mind, we're excited to announce that development is going incredibly well. We are getting closer to reveal the exact release date, so make sure to read more on this below. 🎉

🩸 [b]👨‍⚕️ DR. GORBERG'S MADNESS UNLEASHED[/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/8370192590d657cd60f1c635943ed06e38d67f04.gif[/img]

As you might remember, in Gore Doctor, you'll find yourself in the institute of Dr. Abnel Gorberg, a once-prominent psychiatrist whose desperate quest to save his beloved wife, Scarlett, led him down a path of darkness and despair. Before the darkness consumed him entirely, he was a respected figure in the medical community. However, whispers of concern began to circulate among his colleagues as his obsession with saving his wife, Scarlett, grew more consuming. Some medical experts expressed worry about the state of Dr. Gorberg's mind, fearing that his desperate quest was leading him down a dangerous path.🔪

Rumors swirled of strange experiments being conducted within the walls of Dr. Gorberg's institute, prompting authorities to investigate and uncover the truth behind the whispers. However, despite their efforts, none could halt the downward spiral of Dr. Gorberg's descent into madness. The darkness had already taken hold, and no one could stop the doctor's relentless pursuit of his twisted vision. Trying to escape from his institute, you'll uncover the chilling secrets hidden within its walls and confront the gruesome experiments born from Dr. Gorberg's descent into madness. 💀

🩸 [b]🌟 DARKNESS DESCENDS[/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/406284b037a618a7180c4b251572515bfa1f2215.gif[/img]

Prepare yourselves, brave souls, for as you delve deeper into the heart of Gore Doctor, the shadows grow thicker, and the challenges more daunting. Each step forward takes you further into the depths of Dr. Gorberg's tormented psyche, where every corner hides new horrors and every revelation pushes the boundaries of sanity. 😱

🩸 [b]🔍 UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY, RUN FOR YOUR LIFE![/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/0eb608134fbb1481cce01c9a8a39da1693dcc471.gif[/img]

Will you survive the nightmarish trials that await within Dr. Gorberg's facility? As you uncover clues, unravel the mysteries shrouding Scarlett's fate, and fend off the terrors lurking in the darkness, your courage will be put to the ultimate test. But remember, in Gore Doctor, death may offer the only respite from the madness. 🏃‍♂️💨

🩸 [b]📅 RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT COMING SOON![/b] 🩸

We're absolutely thrilled to announce that we're aiming for a release [b]within this very quarter[/b]! While we're fine-tuning the final details, we'll be sure to keep you updated on the exact release date as soon as possible. Stay tuned to our community channels for the latest news and announcements. 📢

🩸 [b]WISHLIST GORE DOCTOR ON STEAM![/b] 🩸

If you're ready to confront your deepest fears and explore the twisted world of Dr. Abnel Gorberg, don't forget to wishlist Gore Doctor on Steam. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share this harrowing journey with you. 💻🔪

Thank you for joining us on this terrifying adventure. The doctor will see you soon...

As always fearfully Yours,

The Gore Doctor Development Team 👻🕹️

notes.title: Gore Diary #3 - Ensuring your nightmares are real!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/682dd9f312d6ee6a000eb843052060267495971d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Greetings, fearless horror enthusiasts! 💀[/b][/h3]

The development of Gore Doctor is well underway, and we're excited to share some spine-chilling updates on the game's progress. The dark corridors of our tormented doctor's twisted world are coming to life, promising a blood-soaked journey into the macabre, so the time has come to share some additional info on the game and what kind of scary stuff you can expect!

🩸 [b]BOSS BATTLES: FACE THE FREAKY LADY'S DEVILISH STEW[/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/a60fc4c190335d3805b7c6a9c2dee5f6efbecfb5.gif[/img]

Prepare yourselves for the ghastly challenges that await in Gore Doctor. Among the looming horrors, one particularly gruesome adversary stands out—the Freaky Lady (you might know her twin sister from another game). This sinister figure is on a mission to turn you into her special ingredient for a deadly stew. Strategize, stay alert, and be ready to confront this culinary nightmare. Beware - Freaky Lady is just one of the bosses you will encounter in the game!

🩸 [b]UNCOVERING TERROR: CLUES IN UNEXPECTED PLACES[/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/6e3e130ea090d30b292adabe0495d28b69567068.gif[/img]

In Gore Doctor, survival hinges on your ability to navigate the macabre environment and unearth crucial clues. You'll be shocked to discover that keys to locked doors aren't handed to you on a silver platter. Look for them in the most unexpected places, like a fridge filled with decomposing body parts. Exercise caution as you explore, for every corner may hide the clue or key to your escape or the revelation of a deeper horror.

🩸 [b]SACRIFICE FOR SURVIVAL: DARK CHOICES AWAIT[/b] 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342000/d5295672ee41f18c45d47f8a581e6c5b9d19d098.gif[/img]

Survival in Gore Doctor comes at a cost, as some must perish for others to endure. Confront morally ambiguous decisions that force you to make tough choices. Your actions will shape the nightmarish narrative, and the line between right and wrong will blur in the darkness. Brace yourself for a descent into the heart of ethical horror. Well, Gore Doctor might not even give you a choice...

🩸 [b]HAPPY HOLIDAYS AND A TERRIFYING 2024![/b] 🩸

As the year draws to a close, the entire Gore Doctor development team wishes you Happy Holidays filled with spine-tingling joy and a year ahead that's as terrifying as your darkest nightmares. May 2024 bring you thrills, chills, and unforgettable gaming experiences!

🩸 [b]WISHLIST GORE DOCTOR ON STEAM![/b] 🩸

We appreciate your unwavering support on this harrowing journey. If you dare to delve into the depths of Gore Doctor, don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam. Your anticipation fuels our macabre creativity, and we can't wait for you to experience the horrors that await.

Stay vigilant, horror aficionados, for Gore Doctor is on the horizon, ready to plunge you into a nightmare of blood-soaked proportions.

Fearfully Yours,
